sources.title: yuzuki choco (1st costume)
sources.excerpt: It consists of an [[open coat|open]] [[two-sided coat|two-sided]] [[white coat|white]] [[lab coat]] ([[red coat|red]] on the inside), a [[pink shirt|pink]]  [[sleeveless shirt|sleeveless]] [[frilled shirt]] with [[center frills]], a [[black skirt|black]] [[lace-trimmed skirt|lace-trimmed]] [[pencil skirt|pencil]] [[miniskirt]], [[black thighhighs|black]] [[lace-trimmed legwear|lace-trimmed]] [[lace-trimmed thighhighs|thighhighs]] with [[garter straps]], and [[black footwear|black]] [[strappy heels]].
